title: How neurosymbolic AI formalizes natural language into verifiable logic
abstract: Organizations want to automate enforcement of critical rules (financial, legal, regulatory) yet those rules live in ambiguous natural-language documents. Shows how neurosymbolic AI enables subject-matter experts to formalize natural-language rules into mathematical logic, capturing the original intent in an unambiguous, executable, verifiable form. Covers the mathematical foundations and demonstrates how formalized rules serve as agent guardrails, compliance checks, and trusted knowledge sources. Distinguished (500) level.

title: Inside NKI: How AWS designed a kernel language for peak AI performance
abstract: What does a kernel language need to unlock peak performance on Trainium, AWS purpose-built AI chips? The AWS Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a Python-embedded DSL giving developers direct access to Trainium's three-level memory hierarchy and four compute engines. Explores design choices enabling hardware-level optimization, dissects production kernels powering FlashAttention variants, MoE routing, and on-device collectives, and debates where tile-based languages converge across accelerator architectures. Covers how NKI extends to MXFP8 and disaggregated inference. Distinguished (500) level. nvidia lens: accelerator-architecture comparison.

title: Small Language Models, Total Control: Sovereign AI Agents, Lower Cost (sponsored by Boomi)
abstract: Enterprises are waking up to a hard truth: the AI their business depends on runs on infrastructure, models, and pricing they don't control. Boomi shows AI agents that run anywhere you choose (your Amazon VPC, data center, behind your firewall) powered by small language models fine-tuned to each agent's job and served on infrastructure you govern. Full architecture on AWS: Amazon EKS, EC2 GPU instances, Amazon S3, Aurora, MSK, and Amazon Bedrock as a governed escalation path, plus the fine-tuning pipeline (LoRA SFT + DPO), the evaluation gate deciding when a small model is ready, and a live demo of an agent reasoning locally at a fraction of frontier-LLM latency and cost. ai lens: local/self-hosted SLM, the on-host-inference territory.

title: Beyond English: Architecture Patterns for Multilingual AI Voice Agents
abstract: Deploying AI voice agents beyond English introduces unique challenges: accent handling, language detection, code-switching mid-conversation, and cultural nuances in conversation flow. Architecture patterns for building multilingual voice agents using Amazon Connect Agentic Voice. Real-world scenarios from Spanish/English coexistence, German with regional dialects, and Italian conversational AI. When speech-to-speech models work natively, when to fall back to TTS pipelines, how to handle polyglot non-native accents, knowledge base localization. ai lens: directly relevant to EN/ES transcription and multilingual caption work.

title: Beyond English: Architecture Patterns for Multilingual AI Voice Agents [REPEAT]
abstract: Repeat of BIZ316-R. Architecture patterns for multilingual AI voice agents on Amazon Connect Agentic Voice: accent handling, language detection, code-switching, speech-to-speech vs TTS fallback, knowledge base localization.

title: How Enterprises Are Eliminating Phone Menu Trees with Agentic AI
abstract: Large enterprises run complex corporate hotlines: thousands of daily calls in multiple languages spanning diverse business units. Forward-thinking companies replace legacy interactive voice response (IVR) systems with multilingual AI agents from Amazon Connect Customer, achieving high autonomous call handling rates. A practical approach to scaling agentic AI enterprise-wide, including lessons learned and future expansion. Foundational (100) level.

title: Fine-tune and evaluate NVIDIA Nemotron 3 with Amazon SageMaker Serverless Fine-tuning (sponsored by NVIDIA)
abstract: Customize NVIDIA Nemotron 3 using Amazon SageMaker Serverless Fine-tuning without managing training infrastructure. Walks through preparing a dataset, fine-tuning the model, and evaluating the customized model against the base model to measure quality improvements. Attendees leave with a practical workflow for adapting Nemotron to domain-specific use cases on AWS. Hands-on, laptop required. ai + nvidia lens: pairs directly with the QLoRA/fine-tuning + evaluation-gate pipeline work.
